items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight). Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) IR/return. If Flowers can't go, Ravens WR hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP post-W1 hamstring aggravation (left game after 150 yds/TD); Lane to IR.
items.implication: Lean OUT/miss vs Saints; Bateman and others elevated; Andrews target share rises.
items.opportunity: WR2/3 and TE volume expansion for Bateman/Walker/Andrews if Flowers inactive.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring Wednesday practice (Houston Chronicle); history of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024. MRI results key. Week 1 routes: Collins 37/42 on Stroud dropbacks (Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27). Grade 1 strain, DNP Thursday, status jeopardy vs Bengals.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring strain per reports; doctors don't believe serious (Schefter) but DNP Thu and jeopardy for Sunday; past multi-week absences.
items.implication: High risk sit or limited; monitor Friday practice/MRI. If OUT, targets cascade to Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets vacuum if absent; Boutte already 27 routes W1.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied team lead), 24% target share (2nd-highest career). IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Massive three-down/pass-game usage in Chiefs debut; elite matchup vs soft IND run D.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; upside for overall RB1 season if healthy.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share W1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, both RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. RB9 util.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes/targets/RZ; soft matchup.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; three-down role locked.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1; 69% FPts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; 8.5-pt underdog script bad for rush.
items.why: Split backfield + returning Kamara + tough matchup/script.
items.implication: Sit/fade; Miller or Kamara preferred if active.
items.conflict: ETR had Kamara=Miller beneficiary earlier; reverse if Kamara in.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in W1 (tied Bijan lead). 19% tgt share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Overreaction to injury scare fading.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; sustained high-volume profile.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; ROS confidence high (ETR also elevates).

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE vs DET: 69% route participation W1 (higher than any 2025 game), 77% snaps (highest since W9 2024). Top-5 TE util. DET allowed 27 FPts to TEs W1. Efficient per-target history.
items.implication: TE1 upside if role sticks; buy-low if available.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant Wednesday; said Thursday 'I'm ready to go.' Missed W1; expected share with Stevenson vs PIT. AJ Brown IR high-ankle helps need for explosives.
items.why: Full practice + player confirmation post-ankle; W1 inactive.
items.implication: Likely debut/share; flex upside with big-play ability; Stevenson volume dips.
items.opportunity: Explosive carries return; 10+ touch projection reasonable.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a Week 2 waiver wire target (Stribling injury beneficiary).
items.why: Stribling (deltoid) out month+/surgery; Deebo elevated in SF.

items.text: Week 2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo/Demarcus Robinson; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; others (Vele for Tyson, etc). Streaming and FAAB guidance live.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds; reverse Kamara beneficiary if active.
items.opportunity: Immediate role expansion for listed backups.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; averages 93 yds/18 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI D allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite target share + proven Wentz chemistry + soft secondary.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks. SEA allows 3rd-fewest FPts to WRs. Bourne debut further diluted.
items.why: Anemic target share + tough secondary + competition.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; stash better options per ETR.

items.text: Colston Loveland: no TE higher route participation than 89% W1. 0 pts/2 tgts frustrating in 59-pt game but missed EZ throw etc. Buy if owner panics; role elite.
items.why: Highest TE routes; volume will come; bad luck on targets.

items.text: Kenyon Sadiq (16th pick) sneaky optimistic debut: 28 snaps despite missing OTAs/camp (hernia). Schemed goal-line carry + screen + 2 other targets. Clear intent to get him ball.
items.why: Despite limited practice, intentional goal-line/screen usage signals future role.
items.implication: Watch for TE/RB hybrid upside; stash in deep leagues (ETR notes Sadiq beneficiary).
